title: Titanium AUV Propeller Shaft
alloyReason: Grade 23 Ti-6Al-4V ELI (UNS R56401) is mandated for Titanium AUV Propeller Shaft where extra-low interstitial elements (O ≤0.13%, Fe ≤0.25%) provide superior fracture toughness (KIC >100 MPa√m) and fatigue crack growth resistance compared to standard Grade 5. The controlled oxygen content reduces susceptibility to strain-rate embrittlement, making it the preferred choice for Autonomous underwater vehicle propeller shaft in safety-critical applications. This rationale is driven by autonomous underwater vehicle propeller shaft and specific design requirements.
process: Ring forging radial-axial for deep sea geometry
CNC turn-bore operation with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding autogenous with 0.5mm corner radius
Hydrostatic pressure test with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for autonomous underwater vehicle application
commonFailures: Crevice corrosion under biofouling in stagnant seawater - mitigated by CP-Ti Grade 2 + ICCP system — critical for autonomous underwater vehicle performance

faq.q: What is the seawater corrosion rate of Titanium AUV Propeller Shaft?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V exhibits a general corrosion rate of <0.01 mm/year in quiescent seawater and <0.05 mm/year in high-flow (5 m/s) seawater. Unlike stainless steels, Titanium AUV Propeller Shaft is immune to chloride stress corrosion cracking and pitting corrosion up to 260°C. For autonomous underwater vehicle in submerged service, no cathodic protection is required — a significant cost advantage over steel and aluminum.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium AUV Propeller Shaft orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium AUV Propeller Shaft is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium AUV Propeller Shaft?
faq.a: Each Titanium AUV Propeller Shaft shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for autonomous underwater vehicle.
